_comment: The club roster, loaded by scripts/ClubRoster.gd. Yardage is CARRY (GAME_DESIGN.md Section 5). Each entry becomes a club Dictionary with name, min_yard, max_yard, type, brand, limited, ability, effects and staff; omitted fields default to brandless, not limited, and no ability text. `ability` is the card text; `effects` is what the rules read (see ClubAbilities.gd), so the two must agree. `staff` marks a Staff club (Section 3C): the effects that replace its own while the bag holds a 4-set of its brand.
_comment_starter: Bogey-Mart (Section 3A): the starting bag. Never in the draft pool.
_comment_standards: Brandless, always in the pool at standard_copies each, so every yardage gap stays covered.
_comment_brands: Branded clubs (Section 3C), keyed by brand id: ten a brand, two of them Staff clubs. Only the run's live brands enter the pool.

_comment_limited: Limited editions: one copy each, two a brand, in the pool only when their brand is live.

limited.name: Gold Cleek
limited.ability: Once per hole, create a Pure Strike. With a Titanist Wood in bag: twice per hole

limited.name: The Bulger
limited.ability: Create a Big Strike when playing a Wood from rough/bunker, once per hole. With any Wedge in bag: from any lie

limited.name: Old Tom's Niblick
limited.ability: Landing in a bunker adds a Flop Shot to your next draw. With a MacGregorian Wood: once per hole, landing on the fairway adds a Bump and Run

limited.name: The Rutter

limited.name: Old Reliable Putter
limited.ability: Once per round, Steady Hands on a putt. With another Ping-Well club: once every six holes

limited.name: Persimmon Spoon
limited.ability: No distance penalty from rough. With a 2nd MacGregorian: plays from any lie, sand included, as though from the fairway

limited.name: The Equaliser
limited.ability: With 3+ distinct brands in your bag, counts as EVERY brand for set purposes

limited.name: The Surgeon
limited.ability: Once per round, re-draw your Form hand. With a Titanist Iron in bag: once every six holes

limited.name: The Gambler
limited.ability: A called hole you make keeps 3 clubs, not 2. With a Slazinger Wood in bag: a called hole you miss still shows 3

limited.name: Old Faithful
limited.ability: Digging at the draft costs no bad card. With a Callowell Wedge in bag: dig twice a draft

limited.name: The Metronome
limited.ability: Every swing with it is Mid, even below its range. With a Ping-Well Wood in bag: your Stock Shots are straight from any tier

limited.name: The Chameleon
limited.ability: Counts as the brand you carry most of, not as Nimbus. With a Nimbus Wood in bag: counts as both
